product_metadata.title: GREATSSLY Mini Bag Sealer, Portable Bag Heat Sealer Machine with Cutter, Handheld 2 in 1 Chip Bag Sealer for Food Saver Bags Snack Cookie Fruit Storage Plastic Poly Mylar Bags(Batteries NOT Included)
features: 【2 in 1 Bag Sealer & Cutter for 2021】Mini bag sealer made with high-quality ABS material and use Dual-Use Design, one head for sealing, one head for cutting. This sealer bag for food is great for the kitchen, fishing, camping, travel, and more. The internal high-temperature sealing head and the safety slide cover ensure safe use, which is a good helper for the home.

【Keep Food Fresh & Taste】The bag sealer for food plastic bags design to adopting advanced micro heating technology to quickly and evenly seal the bag, effectively seal, and block airborne dust. Keep all foods fresh and dry. Magnetic bottom, can be adsorbed on the refrigerator or any stationary metal surface so you will keep it handy in your kitchen.

【Wide Range Of Applications】This bags sealer is suitable for all kinds of packaging bags, including plastic bags, snack bags, aluminum foil bags, kraft paper bags, cookie bags, potato chips bags, coffee bags, pet food bags, etc. You can also seal your valuables sealed to keep them from the air, reduce oxidation, prevent moisture, and retain their original appearance. NOTE: It is not suitable for ultra-thin plastic bags, ordinary paper bags, and non-hot melt bags.

【Keep Snacks & Food Fresher, Longer】Used to seal the PVC bags that store potato chips, nuts, snacks, grains, and food. The 3D corrugated heating plate has 6 sealing lines. It can more effectively isolate the air, reduce the oxidation speed of food, avoid food waste and mold growth, and retain the original flavor of the food.

【Professional Vacuum Sealing System】 Upgraded sealing technology adopts inverter constant temperature for sealing stability and efficiency. The vacuum sealing process extends the freshness of the food, save your time and money.
【!!!】Save space in your kitchen with this plastic sealer and cutter. It’s designed with a hook for easy hanging, and it's great for a wide range of food packs.
